about.title: Our Journey Since 2014
about.p1: Founded in 2014 in Luanda, PEPEK GRUPO RENT-A-CAR was built on an uncompromising commitment to elevate executive mobility in Angola.
about.p2: Today, we operate from strategic hubs in Luanda, Huambo, and Bengo, serving over 5,000 clients and managing high-level motorcades for governments, embassies, and summits.
about.val1Desc: Real-time fleet tracking and chauffeurs trained in safety protocols and defensive driving.
about.val2Desc: Advance arrival for all transfer services and rigorous route management.
about.val3Desc: Maximum confidentiality and impeccable etiquette for diplomatic missions and corporate executives.
about.val4Desc: 24/7 dedicated account manager to instantly adapt to itinerary changes.
